title: Open Values Citation Bundle v0.1
description: A frozen copy of a facts file, the weights used to rank it and the ranking that came out, so anyone can run the ranking again and check they get the same result.

format.description: Always "open-values-citation-bundle". Tells a reader that this file is a frozen ranking that can be run again.

version.description: The version of the citation bundle format this file follows, 0.1.

id.description: The bundle's id, in lower case with hyphens, such as "banking-fossil-free-green".

title.description: The bundle's name as shown to people.

createdAt.description: The day the bundle was made, as YYYY-MM-DD.

maintainer.description: Who looks after the bundle, such as "Values Commons".

license.description: The licences that cover the bundle, for the data snapshot and for the explanatory text.

purpose.description: One or two sentences saying what question the bundle answers.

rerunCommand.description: The command that runs the ranking again and checks it against the expected result, such as "npm run audit:citations".

source.description: Where the frozen facts came from and the fingerprints that prove which version they are.

lensAssumptions.description: The settings the ranking was made with: the weights, the criteria, how ties are sorted, and the caveats a reader should keep in mind.

query.description: The question put to the facts: rank the whole file and report the top entries plus a few named ones.

lensSnapshot.description: A full copy of the facts file at the moment the bundle was made, so the ranking can be run again without the live site.

expected.description: The result the ranking gave when the bundle was made. Running it again must give the same result.

lensPath.description: The path, inside the repository, of the facts file the snapshot was copied from.

lensId.description: The id of that facts file, such as "banking".

lensHash.description: The facts file's short fingerprint, 8 hexadecimal characters, made by the engine's lensHash function from every entry's code and scores.

snapshotSha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the snapshot, 64 hexadecimal characters, taken over the snapshot written with its keys sorted.

engineVersion.description: The version of the ranking engine (app/engine.js) the bundle was last run with, such as "0.11".

generatedFromBuild.description: The date and time of the site build the facts were copied from, in ISO 8601.

label.description: The facts file's name as shown to people.

type.description: What kind of thing the entries are: Products, Services, Media, Organizations or Initiatives.

valueFrame.description: A sentence saying how to read the ranking: as a fit to these values, not a verdict on the entries.

disclaimer.description: A sentence a reader must see with the ranking, such as "not financial advice".

preset.description: The name of the ready-made weight setting used, such as "Fossil-free & green".

weights.description: The weight given to each criterion, from 0 (ignore) to 5 (matters most), keyed by criterion key.

minCoverage.description: The smallest share of the weighted criteria, from 0 to 1, that an entry must have facts for to be ranked at all.

criteria.description: The criteria of the facts file, as they stood when the bundle was made.

sort.description: How the ranked list is ordered, such as "score descending, then name ascending".

caveat.description: A sentence on what the bundle does not promise, such as that later live data may differ.

kind.description: Always "rank-lens": rank every entry in the facts file.

focus.description: One sentence saying what the ranking is meant to show.

targetCodes.description: The codes of entries whose place in the ranking is reported on its own, whatever their rank.

topN.description: How many of the top-ranked entries are recorded in expected.top.

rank.description: The entry's place in the ranking, starting at 1.

code.description: The entry's code in the facts file.

score.description: The entry's fit score, from 0 to 100, as the engine computed it.

tier.description: The plain label for the score, such as "Excellent fit" or "Mixed fit".

why.description: The labels of the criteria that added most to the score, up to two.

coverage.description: The share of the weighted criteria, from 0 to 1, that the entry has facts for.

reason.description: The one sourced claim the app shows as the main reason: the criterion label, the score, its band, the note, the source link and its date.

weakestAxis.description: The entry's lowest-scoring weighted criterion, as a pair: its label and its score.

engineVersion.description: The engine version that produced this result.

lensHash.description: The short fingerprint of the facts the result was computed from. It must match source.lensHash.

snapshotSha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the snapshot the result was computed from. It must match source.snapshotSha256.

rankedCount.description: How many entries were ranked. Entries with too few facts for the weights are left out.

top.description: The top entries, as many as query.topN, in rank order.

targets.description: The result row for each code in query.targetCodes, keyed by code.
